name: Choose the platform, stand up the account and secure the domain
trigger: on demand
inputs_required: brand brain: budget and team capacity
brand brain: catalogue size and SKU complexity

steps.name: List required features before comparing platforms
steps.does: Reads catalogue size, SKU complexity, budget and design needs and turns them into a written feature list before looking at any platform.
steps.check: Every item on the list ties to a real product or catalogue fact, not a guess.

steps.name: Score total cost of ownership
steps.does: Scores hosting, apps, transaction fees and developer time as one true yearly cost per platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom), not the sticker price.
steps.check: Every cost line carries a source and a date.

steps.name: Recommend platform and plan tier
steps.does: Picks the platform and plan tier with the lowest true cost, and names the exact trigger (order volume, feature need) that should force an upgrade.
steps.check: The memo states a numeric upgrade trigger, not a vague 'when you grow'.
steps.ask_founder_if: budget or catalogue size has not been confirmed with the founder

steps.name: Register the account and enter legal identity
steps.does: Registers under an email the business permanently controls and enters the exact legal identity before any payment or tax setting is touched.
steps.check: Account email is a business domain address, not a personal inbox.

steps.name: Set defaults and turn on account security
steps.does: Sets currency, region and unit defaults once, before any price is entered, and turns on two-factor authentication before payments are activated.
steps.check: 2FA confirmed on before any gateway is touched, checked live not from a settings screenshot.

steps.name: Set staff roles and time-bound agency access
steps.does: Creates custom staff roles and gives any agency collaborator access that expires on a set date rather than standing forever.
steps.check: No collaborator has owner-level access without an end date.
steps.ask_founder_if: an agency needs standing access beyond the current project

steps.name: Buy the domain and avoid the platform default
steps.does: Filters candidate names by brandability, buys the real domain and never launches on the platform's default subdomain.
steps.check: The live storefront never resolves to a *.myshopify.com or platform default URL.

steps.name: Point DNS for the platform and for sender authentication
steps.does: Points DNS at the platform and reuses the same DNS workflow to add SPF, DKIM and DMARC records for sender domain authentication.
steps.check: Every DNS record is verified resolving live, not just saved in the registrar panel.

steps.name: Register near-miss domains and matching TLDs
steps.does: Registers the near-miss spellings and additional TLDs a squatter would use to imitate the brand.
steps.check: Registrar choice favors portability over convenience unless there is a real reason not to.
steps.ask_founder_if: budget is tight and squatting risk is genuinely low for this category

qa: Every claim and number traces to the brand record or a dated web source.
2FA is on before payments are touched.
No leftover agency access without an end date.
DNS verified live, not just saved.
read_point: Kevin reviews the memo and checklist before any payment is set live; DNS re-checked 24-48h after propagation.
typical_duration: agent: 2-3 hours across the three capabilities; waiting: up to 48 hours for DNS propagation and domain registration confirmation.
subagents: store-setup-auditor: runs the cost comparison and setup checklist while domain registration is in progress

name: Select the theme and put safe engineering practice behind it
trigger: on demand | store setup, or after a near-miss where a live edit could not be traced or reverted
inputs_required: GitHub repo access or Shopify CLI

steps.name: List required sections and features
steps.does: Writes the list of sections and features a theme must have before browsing any theme store.
steps.check: List is written before a single theme is opened.

steps.name: Vet 2-3 candidate themes
steps.does: Vets each candidate on PDP quality, mobile behaviour and code quality, not the homepage demo, and scores each against the feature list.
steps.check: Every theme is checked on a real PDP and a real mobile width, not the marketplace preview.

steps.name: Decide free vs paid and pick one
steps.does: Picks the theme with the best fit-to-cost, not the best looking demo.
steps.check: Decision states the runner-up and why it lost.
steps.ask_founder_if: two themes score within 5% and cost differs materially

steps.name: Duplicate the theme before any edit round
steps.does: Never edits the live theme directly; every change round starts on a duplicate or a branch.
steps.check: The live theme's edit history shows zero direct edits.

steps.name: Stand up git, CI and a staging theme
steps.does: Connects the theme repo to GitHub, adds Shopify CLI for local development, runs theme-check linting on every commit, and builds a staging theme URL that auto-deploys from a branch.
steps.output: git repo with commit history, CI config, staging theme URL
steps.check: A commit with a hard theme-check error is blocked from merging.

steps.name: Write the AI build brief before any AI agent touches the storefront
steps.does: Gives the build agent real brand inputs (products, policy, voice), lets it propose a plan first, and asks for exactly one storefront change per prompt.
steps.check: The brief is written and approved before the agent makes its first live edit.

steps.name: Preview privately and QA every AI-authored section
steps.does: Previews every AI-built section privately, never on the public URL, and treats the output as a draft needing manual QA and a claims check.
steps.check: No AI-authored copy ships without a claim-check pass.

steps.name: Require review before merge and keep a tested rollback
steps.does: Requires a second reviewer or the founder gate before merging staging to the live theme, and keeps a one-command rollback to the previous release.
steps.check: Rollback has actually been run once in a drill, not just documented.

steps.name: Document design tokens and check new sections against them
steps.does: Documents color, spacing, typography and component tokens from the live theme, then checks every new section against them and flags drift.
steps.check: A new section that doesn't match a token is flagged before it ships, not after.

steps.name: Maintain a staging environment with real-looking data
steps.does: Keeps a staging copy of the store, theme and a recent product/price snapshot in sync with production, refreshed on a schedule, for every risky change or app trial.
steps.check: Every app trial and AI build-agent session runs against staging, never production.

outputs: git repo with commit history + CI config
qa: No edit ever lands on the live theme without a duplicate/branch and a reviewed PR.
Rollback command tested, not assumed.
AI-authored copy passed claim-check before merge.
New sections checked against the design token doc.
read_point: Founder reviews the PR before merge; token drift checked at every new section's QA.
typical_duration: agent: 1-2 days for initial engineering setup; ongoing: 30-60 minutes per theme change afterward.

name: Build the product catalogue and site architecture
trigger: on demand
inputs_required: brand brain: products (prices, weights, stock, images)

steps.name: Match product type to real fulfilment
steps.does: Sets each product's type to match how it is actually sold and fulfilled, since this drives tax, shipping and reporting behaviour.
steps.check: Every product type matches a real fulfilment path, not a default guess.

steps.name: Turn on inventory tracking and assign SKUs
steps.does: Turns on inventory tracking and gives every product a real SKU.
steps.check: No product ships without a SKU.

steps.name: Enter cost per item
steps.does: Enters a real cost per item on every product so margin reporting works from day one.
steps.check: Cost field is populated with a real number, not left at zero or the platform default.

steps.name: Build variants and verify swatches
steps.does: Builds variant options, prices every row, and verifies swatch colors against real hex values.
steps.check: Every variant row has a price; every swatch matches the real product color.

steps.name: Group gallery images by variant
steps.does: Groups product images by variant so the gallery updates correctly when a shopper changes a selection.
steps.check: No product ships with 0 or 1 image.

steps.name: Decide manual vs smart collections
steps.does: Decides collections deliberately, manual for curated sets and smart (rule-based) for anything that should update itself, and deletes unused default demo collections.
steps.check: No leftover demo collection remains live.

steps.name: Set tag discipline
steps.does: Builds a tag taxonomy so every filter a shopper can select actually returns matching products.
steps.check: Every filter tested live returns at least one correct result.

steps.name: Build navigation around how shoppers think
steps.does: Builds the menu from the shopper's own mental model, capped at 7 top-level items, reachable in 2-3 clicks.
steps.check: A fresh pair of eyes reaches any product in 2-3 clicks.
steps.ask_founder_if: the catalogue does not cleanly fit into 7 or fewer top categories

steps.name: Turn on and QA breadcrumbs
steps.does: Turns on breadcrumb navigation across PDP and collection pages and verifies it live.
steps.check: Breadcrumbs are correct on every template, checked live not in the editor.

qa: Every product has a SKU, a real cost, and at least 2 images.
Every filter tag actually returns matching products when clicked live.
Navigation tested in 2-3 clicks by someone unfamiliar with the site.
read_point: Checked again at pre-launch QA (SITE-W08) and whenever the catalogue changes materially.
typical_duration: agent: 4-8 hours depending on catalogue size; human: spot-checks on the live storefront.

name: Draft legal pages and configure the checkout base
trigger: on demand
human_role: Store compliance and checkout configuration lead
inputs_required: brand brain: shipping and returns practice

steps.name: Draft policy pages from real practice
steps.does: Drafts shipping, returns, privacy and terms pages from the brand's real practice, never a bare template with placeholders left in.
steps.check: No placeholder text remains anywhere in a policy page.

steps.name: Write real shipping terms with a duty disclosure
steps.does: Writes shipping terms that match reality, including a cross-border duties disclosure for any market where it applies.
steps.check: Duty disclosure present for every cross-border market the brand actually ships to.

steps.name: Route to a human for legal sign-off
steps.does: Sends every AI-drafted policy page to a person for legal sign-off before it publishes.
steps.check: No policy page auto-publishes without a human sign-off.
steps.ask_founder_if: no lawyer is available to sign off

steps.name: Point checkout's agree-box at the real terms page
steps.does: Wires the checkout's terms checkbox to the actual published terms page, not a draft or an old version.
steps.check: The link in the live checkout resolves to the current, signed-off terms page.

steps.name: Keep guest checkout on
steps.does: Confirms guest checkout is on and stays on; account creation is never forced.
steps.check: A test purchase completes without creating an account.

steps.name: Minimize checkout fields and separate consent
steps.does: Sets checkout fields to the minimum needed and separates transactional consent from marketing consent so a shopper is never opted into marketing by finishing a purchase.
steps.check: Marketing consent checkbox is unchecked by default.

steps.name: Brand the checkout
steps.does: Applies the brand's logo and colors to checkout within the plan's real branding limits.
steps.check: Checkout visually matches the brand, within what the plan tier allows.

steps.name: Cap coupons and order quantity
steps.does: Enables coupons with a per-user limit and a maximum spend cap, and sets a per-order quantity cap when stock is scarce.
steps.check: A coupon cannot be reused past its cap in a live test.

steps.name: Set one abandoned-checkout email owner
steps.does: Turns on exactly one system (site platform or lifecycle platform, not both) to own the abandoned-checkout email.
steps.check: A real abandoned cart triggers exactly one recovery email, confirmed by test.

qa: No placeholder text left in a policy page.
Guest checkout confirmed on, tested live.
Exactly one system owns the abandoned-checkout email.
read_point: Before launch (feeds SITE-W08); re-checked whenever shipping or return practice changes.
typical_duration: agent: 3-5 hours; human: lawyer sign-off turnaround varies, days to weeks.

name: Configure payments, shipping and tax
trigger: on demand
inputs_required: a real tax professional's confirmation of obligations

steps.name: Verify identity documents for gateway activation
steps.does: Verifies the exact identity documents each payment gateway needs before activation, since a mismatch delays go-live by days.
steps.check: Documents match the gateway's stated requirements exactly.

steps.name: Add a second gateway and regional methods
steps.does: Adds a primary and a second payment gateway plus the regional payment methods that matter in each key market.
steps.check: Every key market has at least one locally trusted payment method.
steps.ask_founder_if: a market's dominant local payment method is not yet supported

steps.name: Set capture timing and fraud screening
steps.does: Sets capture timing and turns on fraud screening (mismatched billing and shipping, high-risk card BIN, order velocity), including a screen for fake cash-on-delivery orders where COD is offered as a market option.
steps.check: Fraud screening confirmed active with a test transaction.

steps.name: Run the sandbox-then-real go-live test
steps.does: Tests every gateway in sandbox, then places one real order and refunds it before the storefront password comes off.
steps.check: A real refunded order appears in the gateway dashboard, not assumed from settings alone.

steps.name: Build shipping zones and assign fulfilment locations
steps.does: Gives every target country an explicit shipping zone and rate, and assigns a fulfilment location to each zone.
steps.check: No country is left in the platform's undefined 'rest of world' bucket by accident.

steps.name: Set the free-shipping threshold from real numbers
steps.does: Sets the free-shipping threshold from the brand's real margin and AOV, and shows the threshold live in cart.
steps.check: Threshold is computed from real margin data, not copied from a competitor.

steps.name: Test every rate bracket edge
steps.does: Tests carts at every weight or value bracket boundary before launch, since edge cases are where shipping math breaks.
steps.check: Every bracket boundary tested with a real cart, not just the middle of each bracket.

steps.name: Confirm real tax obligations before configuring
steps.does: Confirms the brand's real tax obligations with a professional before enabling any calculation, and turns on the platform tax service per registered region.
steps.check: No jurisdiction is configured without a professional's confirmation on file.
steps.ask_founder_if: no tax professional has confirmed obligations yet

steps.name: Decide display and basis rules per jurisdiction
steps.does: Decides inclusive vs exclusive tax display once, consistently, and sets the tax basis (origin/destination) and shipping taxability per jurisdiction's real rule.
steps.check: Rules match each jurisdiction's actual law, not a single global default.

steps.name: Test one product per tax class in 2+ regions
steps.does: Tests one product per tax class in at least two regions before trusting the setup.
steps.check: Every tax class produces the expected tax amount in a live cart test in 2 regions.

qa: A real refunded order proves payment end to end.
Every shipping rate bracket tested at its edge.
Tax obligations confirmed by a professional, not assumed.
Statement descriptor matches the real brand name.
read_point: Immediately before launch; re-run tax QA whenever catalogue, zones or nexus changes.
typical_duration: agent: about 1 day of configuration; human: a few days waiting on gateway verification and tax sign-off.

name: Set up multi-market localization and consent-based tag gating
trigger: on demand | store setup for a US, EU or India-facing brand, or a compliance audit finding

steps.name: Group countries by tax treatment
steps.does: Groups target countries into markets by shared tax treatment, not by geography.
steps.check: Every market group shares one real tax treatment, verified against SITE-W05's tax setup.

steps.name: Verify the plan tier supports the plan
steps.does: Checks the plan tier actually supports per-market theme customization before promising it to the founder.
steps.check: No market feature is promised that the current plan tier cannot deliver.
steps.ask_founder_if: the plan does not support the localization the founder wants

steps.name: Add languages with human review
steps.does: Adds languages with auto-translate plus a human review pass, never machine translation shipped unchecked.
steps.check: Every translated page has had at least one human review pass.

steps.name: Build a per-market catalogue
steps.does: Builds a catalogue per market, excluding products that cannot ship or are not compliant there.
steps.check: No non-compliant or unshippable product is visible in a market's catalogue.

steps.name: Round converted prices naturally
steps.does: Rounds converted per-market prices to a natural local ending instead of a raw currency conversion.
steps.check: Prices read naturally in the local currency, not as an odd conversion artifact.

steps.name: Inventory every firing tag and script
steps.does: Inventories every tracking pixel, tag and script currently firing on first page load before gating any of them.
steps.check: The inventory is built from a real network trace, not the tag manager's own list.

steps.name: Route tags behind consent, keyed to region
steps.does: Routes each tracking tag behind a consent-management layer keyed to the visitor's region and choice, with the correct default: an opt-out Do Not Sell or Share link for US state laws (CCPA, CPRA and others), opt-in for GDPR regions, and opt-in under India's DPDP Act as a market option, reads null for US.
steps.check: Default state matches the visitor's region's actual law.

steps.name: Confirm rejection actually blocks the script
steps.does: Confirms a rejected-consent visitor genuinely does not fire the gated scripts, checked in network requests, not the banner's own claim.
steps.check: A live network trace after rejection shows zero gated requests fired.

steps.name: Keep essential scripts ungated
steps.does: Keeps cart, checkout and payment scripts ungated so a consent choice never breaks a core function, and logs every consent choice for audit.
steps.check: Cart and checkout function identically regardless of the visitor's consent choice.

qa: Consent rejection actually blocks the network request, verified live.
Default consent state matches the visitor's region's law.
Cart/checkout scripts never blocked by a consent choice.
read_point: Founder reviews the market plan before go-live in a new country; consent audit re-run after any tag change.
typical_duration: agent: 1-2 days; human: translation review and legal confirmation, days.

name: Govern the platform: apps, integrations, automations, releases and the mobile app
trigger: monthly | a manual double-entry process is found | a repetitive manual task is found | a platform release lands | per app release
inputs_required: external system's API docs when building an integration

steps.name: Vet any new app before install
steps.does: Vets a candidate app against ratings and a real before/after speed test, and consolidates apps doing the same job.
steps.check: No app installed without a before/after speed measurement.

steps.name: Remove residual code after uninstall
steps.does: Searches for and removes residual theme code left behind after every app uninstall.
steps.check: A search of the theme code shows zero references to an uninstalled app.

steps.name: Map the integration's data contract
steps.does: Maps every field that must sync both ways (inventory, order status, tracking, loyalty points) before writing any integration code.
steps.check: The data contract is written and reviewed before the first line of integration code.

steps.name: Build the integration or Flow automation
steps.does: Builds the custom app or platform Flow automation and registers the needed webhooks, storing API keys only in the platform's secure settings.
steps.check: No API key appears in theme code, a prompt or a chat log.

steps.name: Add retry logic and a sync-gap alert
steps.does: Adds retry-with-backoff on failed webhook deliveries and alerts a human the moment a sync gap is detected, instead of failing silently.
steps.check: A deliberately failed test webhook triggers a human alert within the target window.

steps.name: Wire no-code automation rules
steps.does: Lists recurring manual if-this-then-that actions and wires each into the platform's native automation layer instead of custom code.
steps.check: Each rule tested against a real historical order before going live.

steps.name: Log every automated action
steps.does: Logs every action an automation rule takes so a human can audit what fired and why, and avoids stacking rules that touch the same object.
steps.check: Every fired rule is traceable to a logged reason.

steps.name: Track platform releases on schedule
steps.does: Reads each Shopify Editions release, WooCommerce/WordPress core update, app deprecation notice and API sunset date on its own schedule.
steps.check: Every release relevant to the brand's stack gets a memo within a week of landing.

steps.name: Flag app-retirement opportunities and breaking changes
steps.does: Matches new native features against the current paid app list to flag one worth retiring, and flags any breaking change against code the store actually uses.
steps.check: Every API the store depends on has a tracked sunset date.

steps.name: QA a mobile app release, if the brand has one
steps.does: Checks the app store listing, screenshots, deep links from ads and email, the push opt-in prompt and app-only offers before each release.
steps.check: Deep links tested from a real ad and a real email, not assumed.
steps.ask_founder_if: the brand does not have or is not launching a mobile app

steps.name: Report the adopt-or-ignore call
steps.does: Writes a short adopt-or-ignore recommendation per release instead of a full changelog dump.
steps.check: The memo is short enough to read in under 2 minutes.

qa: No API key ever appears in theme code, a prompt or a chat log.
Every automation rule tested against a real order before going live.
Sync gaps alert a human; nothing fails silently.
read_point: Monthly app/script review; immediately when a release or deprecation notice lands.
typical_duration: agent: 3-5 hours monthly; integration builds: 1-3 days depending on the external system.

name: Run pre-launch QA and launch sequencing
trigger: event: pre-launch

steps.name: Assemble the dependency-ordered checklist
steps.does: Pulls every prior setup workflow's result into one dependency-ordered launch checklist.
steps.check: Every prior setup workflow's output is represented as a checklist line.

steps.name: Buy something end to end
steps.does: Verifies every product is buyable end to end: browse, add to cart, checkout, pay, confirm.
steps.check: A real test purchase completes on at least one product per category.

steps.name: Confirm emails actually arrive
steps.does: Confirms confirmation and shipping emails arrive in a real inbox, not just show as 'configured' in settings.
steps.check: A real email is seen landing in an inbox, not assumed from a settings toggle.

steps.name: Run a full mobile QA pass
steps.does: Runs a full mobile QA pass on the live, password-protected storefront across the brand's real device split.
steps.check: Tested on the brand's actual top 2-3 devices, not a generic phone.

steps.name: Verify the logged-out storefront in incognito
steps.does: Opens an incognito window and clicks every visible element once to catch anything gated behind a stale session.
steps.check: Every visible element was clicked at least once.

steps.name: Close every step with a real customer action
steps.does: Closes every checklist step with the action a real customer would take, never a settings-page glance.
steps.check: No checklist line is marked pass from a settings screen alone.

steps.name: Compile the pass/fail table and go/no-go call
steps.does: Compiles the full pass/fail table and gives a clear go or no-go recommendation.
steps.check: The recommendation is a single clear call, not a hedge.
steps.ask_founder_if: any step fails and the fix needs more than a small brief

steps.name: Remove the password only at 100% pass
steps.does: Removes the storefront password only once every checklist step passes.
steps.check: Password removal timestamp is logged against the final checklist pass.

steps.name: Schedule the first hygiene sweep
steps.does: Schedules the first post-launch hygiene sweep for the end of week one.
steps.check: SITE-W09's first run is scheduled before this workflow closes.

qa: Every checklist item closed with a real customer action, not an admin-panel check.
No password removed until 100% pass.
read_point: The go/no-go call, made once, right before removing the password.
typical_duration: agent: 4-6 hours; human: final go/no-go decision, same day.

name: Monitor post-launch hygiene, uptime and automated regression
trigger: weekly | every theme or app deploy, and nightly | store setup completion

steps.name: Reconcile inventory weekly in month one
steps.does: Reconciles platform inventory against real stock weekly for the first month after launch.
steps.check: Any mismatch is logged with the real stock count next to the platform count.

steps.name: Classify support tickets by root cause
steps.does: Classifies support tickets weekly by root cause to find a thin page or an unclear policy, and hands off anything outside Site's 4 folders.
steps.check: Every ticket cluster of 3+ maps to a named root cause or is handed off.

steps.name: Re-run shipping and tax checks on change
steps.does: Re-runs shipping and tax checks whenever a product, zone or app changes, instead of waiting for the next scheduled sweep.
steps.check: A changed zone or product triggers a same-week re-check.

steps.name: Confirm automations are actually sending
steps.does: Confirms review-request automation is actually sending on a real order, and the payout bank account matches the region's deposit type.
steps.check: A real recent order's timeline shows the review request fired.

steps.name: Sweep for broken links and redirect chains
steps.does: Sweeps for broken links to images, CSS and JS, and collapses any redirect chain to a single 301.
steps.check: No redirect chain longer than one hop remains.

steps.name: Map critical paths into test cases
steps.does: Maps the store's critical paths (home, PDP, filter, cart, discount code, checkout, login) into automated test cases.
steps.check: Every critical path has at least one scripted test.

steps.name: Run the regression suite on every deploy and nightly
steps.does: Runs the suite before and after every theme or app deploy and nightly, with visual diffs across breakpoints and self-healing for cosmetic selector changes.
steps.check: A deploy never ships without a green regression run.

steps.name: Write a bug report with replay on failure
steps.does: Captures video replay, console errors and a network trace on any failure and writes a bug report a developer can act on without re-running it.
steps.check: The bug report is actionable without the developer re-running the test.

steps.name: Run synthetic uptime checks
steps.does: Runs synthetic checks every few minutes on home, PDP, cart, checkout and search from more than one region, plus a full transaction walk on a schedule.
steps.check: A full add-to-cart-to-confirmation walk runs on its own schedule, not just a page-200 check.

steps.name: Track SSL, DNS and real-user load
steps.does: Tracks SSL certificate expiry and DNS resolution separately from page uptime, and pulls real-user page-load data to catch slow-but-not-down degradation.
steps.check: SSL expiry has its own alert, separate from the uptime check.

steps.name: Route alerts with escalation
steps.does: Routes any failure or degradation to a human with an escalation path if unacknowledged, and logs time-to-detect and time-to-fix.
steps.check: Every incident has a logged detect time and fix time.

qa: Every fail has a concrete fix, not a vague warning.
A theme/app deploy never ships without a green regression run.
An outage or degradation reaches a human within the alert routing's target time.
read_point: Weekly hygiene report; regression on every deploy and nightly; uptime continuous.
typical_duration: agent: continuous/automated; human: reviews the weekly report, 15-30 minutes.

name: Build repeat-purchase, wholesale and demand-capture features
trigger: on demand | a high return or exchange volume is found | a top SKU stocks out or a drop is planned
human_role: Feature builder for subscriptions, loyalty, B2B, returns and waitlists

steps.name: Check product-market fit for repeat purchase
steps.does: Checks the product and margin genuinely fit repeat purchase or bundling before proposing a subscription.
steps.check: Repeat-purchase or bundle fit is backed by a real repurchase-rate number.
steps.ask_founder_if: repeat-purchase data is thin or unavailable

steps.name: Add loyalty and wishlist deliberately
steps.does: Adds loyalty only when repeat purchase genuinely matters to margin, and adds a wishlist regardless since it costs little.
steps.check: Loyalty is justified with a margin number, not added by default.

steps.name: Build a separate B2B path
steps.does: Builds a distinct B2B path with a price list and a minimum-order or net-terms rule where wholesale demand is real.
steps.check: B2B pricing never leaks into the consumer-facing price.

steps.name: Never pre-select a subscription option
steps.does: Never pre-selects a subscription option in a quiz or at checkout, and builds distinct pause, skip, swap and cancel flows.
steps.check: A subscription checkbox defaults to unchecked in a live test.

steps.name: Configure the returns portal against real policy
steps.does: Selects and configures a returns app or native flow against the brand's real return window and condition rules.
steps.check: Portal rules match the published return window exactly.

steps.name: Set a real exchange-for-credit incentive
steps.does: Sets an exchange-for-store-credit incentive sized against real margin, with copy matched word-for-word to the published returns policy.
steps.check: Incentive amount is computed from real margin, not a round guess.

steps.name: Capture structured return reasons
steps.does: Surfaces return reasons in structured form so the data feeds product and copy fixes, and hands restocking/refund-timing rules to operations.
steps.check: Return reasons are queryable, not free text only.

steps.name: Build the restock notify-me capture
steps.does: Adds a notify-me capture on any out-of-stock PDP, firing an automatic notification the moment the SKU restocks, ranked by signup order.
steps.check: A test signup receives the restock notification automatically.

steps.name: Build a password-protected coming-soon page
steps.does: Builds a password-protected coming-soon page for a pre-launch or drop, kept out of search indexes.
steps.check: The page is confirmed excluded from search indexing.

steps.name: Own the signup list and report conversion
steps.does: Captures every signup into the brand's own list, never a third party's, and reports waitlist size and back-in-stock conversion per SKU.
steps.check: Signups land in the brand's own list, verified by export.

qa: No subscription option pre-selected anywhere.
Returns portal copy matches the published policy word for word.
Waitlist signups land only in the brand's own list.
read_point: Founder gate before any feature goes live; waitlist conversion reviewed at the next reorder decision.
typical_duration: agent: 1-2 days per feature; human: app configuration and legal wording check.

name: Design and build homepage, PDP and collection layout
trigger: on demand

steps.name: Build the homepage in a fixed, orienting order
steps.does: Builds the homepage in a fixed, conversion-supportive section order designed to orient and route shoppers fast, not convert directly.
steps.check: Section order matches the brand's approved template, not an ad hoc arrangement.

steps.name: Set focal points on hero and banner images
steps.does: Sets a focal point on every hero and banner image so mobile cropping never cuts off the subject.
steps.check: Mobile crop checked on the brand's real device width.

name: Run the CRO test lifecycle: design, launch, read, roll out and protect
trigger: on demand | event: before test launch | event: test reaches read point | quarterly
inputs_required: registry: prior test results on this brand

steps.name: Check the traffic gate
steps.does: Checks the traffic gate: below the sample-size threshold, plans a bigger change instead of running more small tests.
steps.check: Traffic gate check happens before any test is designed, not after it underperforms.

steps.name: Size the test from the minimum detectable effect
steps.does: Sizes the test from the minimum detectable effect, stated as orders per variant, and computes runtime from arms x sample / weekly traffic, at least 2 full weeks covering each weekday twice.
steps.check: Sample size is stated as orders per variant, never a flat magic number.

steps.name: Set the stopping rule before launch
steps.does: Picks a stopping rule before launch and never peeks outside planned looks; randomizes by user with sticky bucketing and isolates returning-visitor traffic.
steps.check: Stopping rule is written down before the test goes live.

steps.name: QA the test on real devices
steps.does: QAs the test 2-3 times on real devices, confirms tracking fires in both arms, and checks for flicker on a slow connection.
steps.check: Tracking confirmed firing in both arms before launch.

steps.name: Check the promo calendar and run an A/A if needed
steps.does: Checks the promo calendar for overlap, and runs an A/A test when starting a new programme or switching tools.
steps.check: No test launches into an unnoticed promo overlap.
steps.ask_founder_if: a promo overlaps the planned test window

steps.name: Count conversions on a confirmation event
steps.does: At the read point, counts conversions on a confirmation event, never clicks, and never calls a test on one good or bad day.
steps.check: Conversion counted on a real confirmation event, not a click proxy.

steps.name: Check SRM, novelty and device splits
steps.does: Checks sample ratio mismatch, novelty/primacy with a daily plot, and the mobile-only and desktop-only splits before trusting the average.
steps.check: SRM checked and cleared before any result is trusted.

steps.name: Decide from the interval and business value
steps.does: Applies Twyman's law to any surprising win, and decides from the confidence interval and business value together, never p<0.05 alone.
steps.check: Decision cites both the interval and the business value, not a p-value alone.

steps.name: Ship the winner and re-verify
steps.does: Ships the winner as the new control, re-verifies it with fresh recordings and funnel data after shipping, and runs an LTV/returns check before scaling any angle- or claim-driven win.
steps.check: Re-verification happens after shipping, not assumed from the test result alone.

steps.name: Maintain the live-winner register
steps.does: Keeps a live-winner register and re-checks quarterly that every shipped winner is still live, setting founder expectations at a 10-20% win rate for PDP/cart/checkout tests.
steps.check: Every past winner is re-checked live at least once a quarter.

steps.name: Report programme value from a holdout
steps.does: When measuring a feature, popup or the whole programme, reports value from a holdout instead of its own engagement metric or the sum of test lifts.
steps.check: Programme value is never reported as the sum of individual test lifts.

steps.name: State and challenge the identifying assumption
steps.does: States and challenges the identifying assumption before trusting any causal method, and checks the traffic gate before choosing a holdout design.
steps.check: The identifying assumption is written down and challenged, not assumed.

steps.name: Steady noisy revenue tests
steps.does: Turns on CUPED only for returning, identified users, and winsorizes outlier orders or uses a proportion metric to steady a noisy revenue test.
steps.check: A noisy revenue metric is steadied with a named technique, not ignored.

steps.name: Log the full chain to the registry
steps.does: Logs the full test-to-result-to-protection chain to the registry for the next backlog cycle.
steps.check: Every test's full lifecycle is retrievable from the registry.

qa: No verdict from a p-value alone.
No peeking outside the planned looks.
A shipped winner re-verified quarterly, not assumed permanent.
Holdout design states its identifying assumption in writing.
read_point: At the pre-set read point (never earlier); quarterly for winner protection and holdout measurement.
typical_duration: agent: design and QA, half a day; test runtime: 2+ weeks; read and rollout, half a day.
